items.title: DraftKings (DKNG) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut As Analysts Rework Growth Outlook
items.summary: DraftKings just saw its modeled fair value price target nudged lower from US$34.45 to US$33.23, a small reset that still matters if you track the stock closely. Street research remains split, with analysts adjusting price targets as they debate how prediction markets, marketing spend and long term profitability goals shape the equity story.
